elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: The added warranty requires services to conform in all material respects to the Agreement and applicable plan, but does not require professional and workmanlike performance.

elements.element: Deliverables other than software conform to applicable documentation.
elements.evidence: The clause addresses delivered software and requires services to conform to the Agreement and applicable plan, but does not warrant that non-software deliverables conform to documentation.
RevMed warrants that delivered software will conform in all material respects to its documentation.

elements.evidence: The operative duration is only 30 days following performance.

result.reason: The redline reaches the expressly stated fallback: 90 days for software, 30 days for services, and repair, replacement/re-performance, or refund remedies at Sanofi's election. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits the professional-and-workmanlike and malicious-code warranties, does not cover non-software deliverables' conformity to documentation, and uses shorter durations. The addition is substantively limited to the fallback warranty and does not conflict with Section 13.5 because that disclaimer preserves warranties expressly stated in Article XIII. Drafting quality is reduced because the new provision is unnumbered and its remedy syntax—'repair, replace or re-perform the non-conforming software or services'—does not clearly map each remedy to the applicable subject.
